Assess Clean Run Evidence

Source: R/repro_indicators.R
assess_clean_run_evidence.Rd

Checks that the folder ships proof the analysis was run end to end in a clean session, such as a sessionInfo() capture or a run log. Its absence is a low severity warn. Returns evidence with indicator_id = "R-REPRO-006".

Usage

assess_clean_run_evidence(path, ctx = NULL, config = NULL)

Arguments

path

Path to the submission's analysis code folder.

ctx

A run context from r4subcore::r4sub_run_context(). When NULL a default context is created from the folder name.

config

A configuration from repro_config_default(). When NULL the default configuration is used.

Value

A validated evidence table.

Examples

d <- file.path(tempdir(), "sub006")
dir.create(d, showWarnings = FALSE)
writeLines("R version", file.path(d, "sessionInfo.txt"))
ev <- suppressMessages(assess_clean_run_evidence(d))
ev$result
#> [1] "pass"
